package spend

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/viant/bindly/resource"
	"github.com/viant/datly/application"
	"github.com/viant/datly/bootstrap"
	packageresources "github.com/viant/datly/bootstrap/resources"
	"github.com/viant/datly/internal/testharness/mcpclient"
	"github.com/viant/datly/internal/testharness/sqlite"
	"github.com/viant/datly/report"
	dsql "github.com/viant/datly/sql"
	"github.com/viant/datly/typecatalog"
	"github.com/viant/mcp-protocol/schema"
	"github.com/viant/x"
	xmodule "github.com/viant/x/module"
)

const packagePath = "github.com/viant/datly/testfixture/composereload/spend"
const testRuntimeTimeout = 250 * time.Millisecond

type composeFixture struct {
	db        *sqlite.Harness
	stage     string
	resources []*resource.Store
	testTimeoutMs int
}

func (f *composeFixture) compile(ctx context.Context, types *typecatalog.Catalog) (*application.Build, error) {
	workspace, err := (xmodule.LocalWorkspace{BaseDir: f.stage}).Resolve(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	routes, err := (bootstrap.PackageDiscovery{Workspace: workspace, Include: []string{packagePath}}).Discover(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(routes) != 1 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("emitted base holders=%d, want 1", len(routes))
	}
	if err = routes[0].ValidateContractTypes(reflect.TypeOf(SpendInput{}), reflect.TypeOf(SpendOutput{})); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	component, err := routes[0].Resolve(reflect.TypeOf(SpendInput{}), reflect.TypeOf(SpendOutput{}))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if component.Settings.Report == nil || component.Settings.Report.Compose == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("emitted cube/compose metadata missing")
	}
	settings := component.Settings.Report.Compose.Normalize()
	if !settings.Enabled || settings.MaxCubes != 8 || settings.MaxLimit != 100 || settings.TimeoutMs != 30000 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("reloaded defaults=%+v", settings)
	}
	// Keep the emitted/default contract assertion above, but do not make every
	// transport and retained-generation acceptance test spend 30 seconds proving
	// that the same context deadline is honored. This override is confined to the
	// generated test fixture and is applied before runtime compilation.
	if f.testTimeoutMs > 0 {
		component.Settings.Report.Compose.TimeoutMs = f.testTimeoutMs
	}
	assets, err := (packageresources.Loader{Workspace: workspace, Packages: []string{packagePath}}).Load(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	compilation, err := report.NewProjectCompiler(report.ProjectConfig{Types: types}).CompileArtifacts([]bootstrap.ArtifactInput{{Component: component, Resources: assets.Store, InputType: reflect.TypeOf(SpendInput{}), OutputType: reflect.TypeOf(SpendOutput{})}})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("derive report from emitted holder (canonical columns=%d, generated output=%v): %w", len(component.RootView.Columns), reflect.TypeOf(SpendOutput{}), err)
	}
	got := map[string]string{}
	for _, artifact := range compilation.Artifacts() {
		c := artifact.Component()
		if len(c.Routes) != 1 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("component %s routes=%d", c.Name, len(c.Routes))
		}
		got[c.Name] = c.Routes[0].Method + " " + c.Routes[0].Path
	}
	want := map[string]string{"Spend": "GET /spend", "SpendCube": "POST /spend/cube", "SpendCubeCompose": "POST /spend/cube/compose"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("report-derived endpoints=%v want=%v", got, want)
	}
	registered, err := compilation.RuntimeComponents(ctx, report.RuntimeConfigureFunc(func(_ context.Context, a *report.ComponentArtifact) (report.RuntimeCapabilities, error) {
		if a.IsReport() {
			return report.RuntimeCapabilities{}, nil
		}
		reader, err := a.ReaderCompilation().NewExecution(bootstrap.ReaderRuntimeConfig{SQL: &dsql.SQLComponent{DB: f.db.DB}})
		return report.RuntimeCapabilities{Reader: reader}, err
	}))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	types, err = compilation.Types()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	f.resources = append(f.resources, assets.Store)
	return &application.Build{Types: types, Resources: assets.Store, Components: registered}, nil
}

func TestComposeReload(t *testing.T) {
	stage1, err := filepath.Abs("..")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	stage2 := os.Getenv("DATLY_COMPOSE_STAGE")
	if stage2 == "" {
		t.Fatal("second emitted generation required")
	}
	for _, protocol := range []struct{ name, version string }{{"http", ""}, {"mcp-registry", ""}, {"mcp-session", schema.LegacyProtocolVersion}, {"mcp-stateless", schema.LatestProtocolVersion}} {
		t.Run(protocol.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 150*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			db := sqlite.New(t)
			if err := db.ExecStatements(ctx,
				`CREATE TABLE spend(tenant TEXT,account_id INTEGER,channel TEXT,amount REAL,version INTEGER)`,
				`INSERT INTO spend VALUES ('acme',1,'web',100,1),('acme',1,'web',50,1),('acme',1,'store',2000,1),('acme',2,'web',70,1),('acme',2,'store',30,1),('other',1,'web',9000,1),('other',2,'store',8000,1),('acme',1,'web',10,2),('acme',2,'store',20,2)`); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			types := typecatalog.NewCatalog()
			for _, typ := range []reflect.Type{reflect.TypeOf(SpendInput{}), reflect.TypeOf(SpendOutput{}), reflect.TypeOf(ChannelPredicate{})} {
				if err := types.Register(typecatalog.TypeOriginPackage, x.NewType(typ)); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			manager, err := application.New(types)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			fixture := &composeFixture{db: db, stage: stage1, testTimeoutMs: int(testRuntimeTimeout / time.Millisecond)}
			if err = manager.Reload(ctx, application.Request{Revision: 1, Compile: fixture.compile}); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			current := composeClient{ctx: ctx, manager: manager, registry: protocol.name == "mcp-registry"}
			if protocol.version != "" {
				current.native = (mcpclient.Config{Source: manager, ProtocolVersion: protocol.version}).New(t)
			}
			current.check(t, 1)
			pinned, service, err := manager.Pin(ctx)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			old := composeClient{ctx: pinned, manager: manager, registry: current.registry}
			if protocol.version != "" {
				old.native = (mcpclient.Config{Service: service, ProtocolVersion: protocol.version}).New(t)
			}
			fixture.stage = stage2
			if err = manager.Reload(ctx, application.Request{Revision: 2, Compile: fixture.compile}); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if manager.Revision() != 2 {
				t.Fatal("generation 2 not published")
			}
			current.check(t, 2)
			old.check(t, 1)
			files, err := fs.Glob(DatlyResources, "sql/*.sql")
			if err != nil || len(files) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("emitted SQL=%v err=%v", files, err)
			}
			embedded, err := DatlyResources.ReadFile(files[0])
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			for i, store := range fixture.resources {
				data, err := store.ReadFile(DatlyResourceNamespace + ":" + files[0])
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if !strings.Contains(string(data), fmt.Sprintf("s.version <= %d", i+1)) || i == 0 && string(data) != string(embedded) {
					t.Fatalf("resource generation %d: %s", i+1, data)
				}
			}
			bad := t.TempDir()
			if err = os.CopyFS(bad, os.DirFS(stage2)); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err = os.Remove(filepath.Join(bad, "spend", files[0])); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			fixture.stage = bad
			if err = manager.Reload(ctx, application.Request{Revision: 3, Compile: fixture.compile}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), files[0]) {
				t.Fatalf("missing-resource stage=%v", err)
			}
			if manager.Revision() != 2 || len(fixture.resources) != 2 {
				t.Fatal("failed stage replaced generation")
			}
			current.check(t, 2)
			old.check(t, 1)
			// A complete configured timeout is exercised on both retained generations.
			// HTTP also proves a shorter caller deadline and active cancellation.
			for _, generation := range []struct {
				name   string
				client composeClient
			}{{"current", current}, {"pinned-old", old}} {
				t.Run(generation.name, func(t *testing.T) { generation.client.deadlines(t) })
			}
		})
	}
}
